transcript.text: What's a money mistake you see people
make before they realize it's a problem?
>> Lifestyle. I know a lot of guys who
spend 100% of their check into their
40s. [music]
Because they want to live a certain way
or like look a certain way.
Right or wrong, the amount of risk you
can take in your business is simply
inversely proportional to the amount of
risk you take in your lifestyle. I would
say for me, really big opportunities
come once every two-ish [music] years.
All the times I don't have the big
opportunity, I just save with the faith
that I will see it when it comes. And
that just means that when it does come,
I'll be able to back the truck up
because I'll have stuff I'll have a
truck. And I can back it up rather than
being like, "Oh wow, there's a bunch of
gold and all I have is what I can carry
with my two hands."
